nodes.label: CORS Configuration
nodes.rationale: Browsers block cross-origin requests, so the Django backend must explicitly allow the frontend origin via CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS; all origins allowed in DEBUG/dev, restricted to specific frontend URLs in production for security.

nodes.label: render.yaml Blueprint
nodes.rationale: render.yaml uses fromService/fromDatabase links so backend and frontend URLs and the database connection string are injected automatically, removing manual configuration and keeping services linked across redeploys.

nodes.label: Netlify Static Hosting
nodes.rationale: Frontend moved to Netlify free static hosting with custom domain freecertify.org for free hosting, professional domain, and better CDN performance, while backend and database stay on Render.

nodes.label: Freemium Pro Subscription
nodes.rationale: Free tier must stay genuinely valuable to scale ad revenue and democratize access; a single $6.99/mo Pro tier with a no-credit-card 7-day trial avoids decision paralysis and converts better than discounts since users form habits around Pro features.

nodes.label: Advertising Revenue Stream
nodes.rationale: Tech-educated mobile users command premium CPM ($8-18), so ads shown only to free users between lessons (never between questions) scale revenue linearly with the user base without harming learning.

nodes.label: Certification Affiliate Commissions
nodes.rationale: Highest-intent stream: users who score 75%+ on a mock exam are shown affiliate voucher links (AWS, PearsonVUE, Prometric, Udemy, Coursera) at the moment of peak purchase intent.

nodes.label: B2B Teams License
nodes.rationale: Highest revenue ceiling and leverage point: one mid-size company deal equals 300+ individual Pro subscribers; deferred to Phase 3 due to long sales cycles.

nodes.label: Verified Digital Certificates
nodes.rationale: LinkedIn-visible, Credly/OpenBadges-verified credentials monetize completed effort ($9.99) and drive organic growth via certificate sharing.

nodes.label: Streak Mechanics Drive LTV
nodes.rationale: Users with 30+ day streaks have 6x lower churn, 3x higher Pro conversion, and 8x higher referral likelihood, so every feature should protect and extend streaks (Duolingo strategy).

nodes.label: Gamification System
nodes.rationale: Hearts, XP, streaks, leagues, gems, and badges apply Duolingo's proven engagement loop to tech education to build daily habits and retention.

nodes.label: Code Splitting & Lazy Loading
nodes.rationale: React.lazy and dynamic imports (jsPDF/html2canvas) avoid shipping unused code on first load, cutting initial bundle ~800KB to ~300KB and improving TTI for slow mobile networks.

nodes.label: Backend Caching Layer
nodes.rationale: Exam questions rarely change, so caching serialized responses (LocMem/Redis) serves repeat requests in ~5ms instead of 150ms and offloads the database.

nodes.label: Query Prefetching (N+1 Fix)
nodes.rationale: prefetch_related/select_related collapses the N+1 query problem (51 queries to 2) when loading questions with answers, cutting response time from 200ms to 40ms.

nodes.label: Intelligent Random Enrichment
nodes.rationale: Below 100 questions the pool always fills; at/above 100 a configurable 15% probability triggers small 10-20 question batches, balancing a fresh, growing pool against AI API cost.

nodes.label: Pre-Generation Endpoint
nodes.rationale: Generating questions when the user clicks the exam tab (before the exam starts) runs in the background and improves perceived exam load times.

nodes.label: AI Question Generation
nodes.rationale: Questions are generated once via OpenAI GPT-4o-mini or Manus and stored in the database to reduce API costs, improve load times, and ensure consistency.

nodes.label: Resource Optimization - Question Pool Enrichment
nodes.rationale: Enriches the question pool with 15% probability once pool reaches 100 to keep content fresh while minimizing OpenAI/Manus API costs; balances cost and quality automatically.

nodes.label: Render Deployment Config
nodes.rationale: Avoids DB-dependent commands during build because Render free Postgres can be sleeping; runs migrations at runtime with retry loop until the database is reachable.

nodes.label: Issues Faced & Solutions
nodes.rationale: Documents 11 technical issues and resolutions, e.g. cookie-based Google Translate over DOM manipulation, lazy-loading heavy PDF libraries to reduce bundle size, and activating venv to avoid Django import errors.
